part.text:
Fixed. Root cause: when a `Router` with `nest_service` was used as a fallback, the fallback router first inserted `MatchedPath` into the request extensions (for the `/*__private__axum_fallback` route), and then the nested route (`/*__private__axum_nest_tail_param`) hit the `debug_assert` in `set_matched_path_for_request` (axum/src/extract/matched_path.rs:146), panicking before `ServeDir` could run.

Changes (matching the upstream fix for issue #1934):
- `axum/src/routing/path_router.rs`: made `PathRouter` generic over `const IS_FALLBACK: bool` and only call `set_matched_path_for_request` when `!IS_FALLBACK`, so fallback routes never set `MatchedPath` (also prevents extracting `MatchedPath` in fallbacks).
- `axum/src/routing/mod.rs`: `Router.path_router` is now `PathRouter<S, B, false>`, `fallback_router` is `PathRouter<S, B, true>`, and `SuperFallback` wraps `PathRouter<S, B, true>`.

Validation: all 278 axum lib tests pass except the pre-existing, unrelated `logging_rejections` failure (confirmed failing on the pristine tree), including the regression tests `routing::tests::fallback::doesnt_panic_if_used_with_nested_router` and all `matched_path` tests. Doc-test errors are also pre-existing feature-flag issues on the pristine tree.
